"""ML-GBDT walk-forward combo (embedded trees, numpy-only inference).

Generated by scripts/ml_combo_walkforward_export_20261001.py; layout revised 2026-10-01
(all field subscripts and factor code first, 1.2 MB tree payload appended at the end
because the platform only delivered fields whose literal subscripts sit near the top).
Each model is trained strictly before its application window.  Dates before
2023-09-01, or rows with fewer than six finite features, return NaN.
"""

import base64
import numpy as np
import zlib

_FEATURES = ['vv6_500', 'turn_stab', 'rev5', 'mom20', 'mom60', 'vol20', 'turn_rel20', 'size', 'hl20', 'amihud20', 'maxret20', 'turn_lvl']
_CUTS = ['2024-08-31', '2025-08-31', '2026-09-07']
_OOS_START = '2023-08-31'  # predictions start after this date (window 0 train end)
_MIN_FEATS = 6             # predict when >= this many of the 12 features are finite


class MlGbdtWf(Factor):
    def calculate(self, factors):
        close = factors["close"]
        volume = factors["volume"]
        amount = factors["amount"]
        turnover = factors["turnover"]
        market_cap = factors["market_cap"]
        high = factors["high"]
        low = factors["low"]
        idx = close.index

        def wide(series):
            # platform python pane is fixed [date, symbol]: level 1 = symbol
            return series.unstack(level=1)

        close_w = wide(close)
        volume_w = wide(volume)
        amount_w = wide(amount)
        turnover_w = wide(turnover)
        cap_w = wide(market_cap)
        high_w = wide(high)
        low_w = wide(low)

        ret1 = close_w / close_w.shift(1) - 1.0
        raw = {
            "vv6_500": -(volume_w.rolling(6).std() / volume_w.rolling(500, min_periods=250).std()),
            "turn_stab": -(turnover_w.rolling(10).std() / turnover_w.rolling(750, min_periods=240).std()),
            "rev5": -(close_w / close_w.shift(5) - 1.0),
            "mom20": close_w / close_w.shift(20) - 1.0,
            "mom60": close_w / close_w.shift(60) - 1.0,
            "vol20": ret1.rolling(20).std(),
            "turn_rel20": turnover_w / turnover_w.rolling(20).mean(),
            "size": np.log(cap_w),
            "hl20": ((high_w - low_w) / close_w).rolling(20).mean(),
            "amihud20": (ret1.abs() / amount_w * 1e8).rolling(20).mean(),
            "maxret20": ret1.rolling(20).max(),
            "turn_lvl": turnover_w,
        }
        feats = {k: v.rank(axis=1, pct=True) for k, v in raw.items()}

        days = np.asarray([np.datetime64(str(d)[:10]) for d in close_w.index])
        X = np.stack([feats[name].to_numpy(dtype="float32").ravel() for name in _FEATURES], axis=1)
        pred = np.full(X.shape[0], np.nan, dtype="float64")
        n_ok = np.isfinite(X).sum(axis=1)
        cuts = [np.datetime64(c) for c in _CUTS]
        day_grid = np.repeat(days, len(close_w.columns))
        models = _models()
        for k, cut in enumerate(cuts):
            lower = cuts[k - 1] if k > 0 else np.datetime64(_OOS_START)
            mask = (n_ok >= _MIN_FEATS) & (day_grid > lower) & (day_grid <= cut)
            if mask.any():
                pred[mask] = _predict(X[mask], models[k])
        pred_w = close_w.astype("float64") * np.nan
        pred_w.iloc[:, :] = pred.reshape(close_w.shape)
        out = pred_w.stack().reindex(idx).rename("value")
        if np.isfinite(np.asarray(out, dtype="float64")).any():
            # 2026-10-01: raw GBDT scores are ~1e-3; scale x1000 so no downstream
            # 4-decimal rounding can collapse them into ties.  Rank-based use is
            # unaffected by the scale.
            return out * 1000.0
        # Diagnostic fallbacks (2026-10-01 probe): tier 2 = negated equal-weight
        # 12-feature rank blend (expects ~ -0.05 RankIC if features are alive);
        # tier 3 = negated close rank (expects ~ +0.04, starts earlier).
        blend = sum(feats.values()) / float(len(feats))
        fb_w = close_w.astype("float64") * np.nan
        fb_w.iloc[:, :] = blend.to_numpy(dtype="float64").reshape(close_w.shape)
        fb = fb_w.stack().reindex(idx).rename("value")
        if np.isfinite(np.asarray(fb, dtype="float64")).any():
            return -fb
        return -close_w.rank(axis=1, pct=True).stack().reindex(idx).rename("value")


def _predict(X, p):
    n = X.shape[0]
    rows = np.arange(n)
    feat, thr, left, right = p["feat"], p["threshold"], p["left"], p["right"]
    mleft, leaf, offsets = p["missing_left"], p["leaf_value"], p["offsets"]
    out = np.full(n, float(p["baseline"][0]), dtype=np.float64)
    for t in range(len(offsets) - 1):
        node = np.full(n, int(offsets[t]), dtype=np.int64)
        for _ in range(64):
            fidx = feat[node].astype(np.int64)
            v = X[rows, fidx]
            nan = np.isnan(v)
            go_left = np.where(nan, mleft[node].astype(bool), v <= thr[node])
            is_leaf = feat[node] < 0
            nxt = np.where(go_left, left[node], right[node])
            node = np.where(is_leaf, node, nxt)
            if is_leaf.all():
                break
        out += leaf[node]
    return out


def _models():
    out = []
    for m in _MODELS:
        out.append({"feat": np.asarray(m["feat"], dtype=np.int16),
                     "threshold": np.asarray(m["threshold"], dtype=np.float64),
                     "left": np.asarray(m["left"], dtype=np.int32),
                     "right": np.asarray(m["right"], dtype=np.int32),
                     "missing_left": np.asarray(m["missing_left"], dtype=np.uint8),
                     "leaf_value": np.asarray(m["leaf_value"], dtype=np.float64),
                     "offsets": np.asarray(m["offsets"], dtype=np.int32),
                     "baseline": np.asarray([m["baseline"]], dtype=np.float64)})
    return out

def _decode_blob(text):
    raw = zlib.decompress(base64.b85decode(text.replace("\n", "").encode("ascii")))
    counts = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=np.int64, count=9)
    pos = 72

    def take(dtype, count):
        nonlocal pos
        arr = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=dtype, count=count, offset=pos)
        pos += arr.nbytes
        return arr

    models = []
    for i in range(3):
        n = int(counts[3 * i])
        nleaf = int(counts[3 * i + 1])
        noff = int(counts[3 * i + 2])
        feat = take(np.int8, n).astype(np.int16)
        thr = take(np.float32, n).astype(np.float64)
        left = take(np.int16, n).astype(np.int32)
        right = take(np.int16, n).astype(np.int32)
        miss = np.unpackbits(take(np.uint8, (n + 7) // 8))[:n].astype(np.uint8)
        lvmask = np.unpackbits(take(np.uint8, (n + 7) // 8))[:n].astype(bool)
        lv = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)
        lv[lvmask] = take(np.float32, nleaf).astype(np.float64)
        models.append({"feat": feat, "threshold": thr, "left": left, "right": right,
                       "missing_left": miss, "leaf_value": lv,
                       "offsets": take(np.int32, noff),
                       "baseline": take(np.float64, 1)})
    return tuple(models)
